prompt: Create a static interactive quiz site for an Alan Watts-inspired wisdom brand called What Alan Watts Talk Should I Listen To? Visual style: cinematic Zen editorial, warm parchment, black ink typography, soft cosmic gradients, calm cards. Hook: Tell Us Your Existential Crisis. We'll Suggest the Talk. Sections: hero, mood selector quiz, topic cards (ego, time, death, love, play, work, fear, consciousness), result card, suggested video placeholder, reflection journal prompt, related essays, newsletter. Add JavaScript for quiz logic and localStorage to save results.
